criteria.text: Identifies that the Underwriting Agreement lacks selling restrictions (e.g. Rule 144A / Regulation S for the US, prospectus exemptions for Canada and the EEA) and recommends adding them.
Identifies the inconsistency between 88,000,000 shares in issue in the Prospectus and 89,250,000 in the Underwriting Agreement recital, which must be reconciled before pricing.

Identifies that the comfort letter cut-off of 22 February 2026 is 15 days before the 9 March 2026 pricing date, outside the 3-business-day requirement in Clause 7(b), so a bring-down letter is needed.
Lists securities-law exemptions/registrations required for each offering jurisdiction and states they are not addressed.
States the gap between cut-off and pricing as a duration (15 calendar days) and identifies the latest compliant cut-off date.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
